---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new tool, a capability, or an improvement to an existing one
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way today? Describe the problem rather than the solution.

## Proposed solution

What you would like godot-mcp to do. If it is a new tool, a sketch of its name (`godot_<verb>_<thing>`) and parameters is welcome.

## Alternatives

Other approaches you considered, including workarounds you use today.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps: Godot file examples (`.tscn`, `.tres`), links, or the MCP client you use.
